name: Codalio Blueprint
description: A Cursor-style planning agent page: one big AI chat that runs the Codalio Blueprint skills (PRD builder, MVP checklist, GTM plan, architecture evaluation, doc generation, code-to-PRD), streaming every step while the project folder tree and each generated document stay visible.

permissions.reason: Contributes one dedicated app-bar page that hosts the planning agent chat, the project file tree, and the document viewer.
Runs each planning lens (product/scope, architecture-lite, GTM-lite), the synthesis pass, and the other Blueprint skills through the active workspace model endpoint.
Export a generated planning document to a Markdown file the user chooses. Generated documents are otherwise kept only in the plug-in's own local project store.
Copy a generated planning document or a single agent step to the clipboard on explicit user action.

commands.title: Codalio Blueprint: Open Planning Agent
commands.description: Open the Cursor-style planning agent page with the chat, project file tree, and document viewer.

commands.title: Codalio Blueprint: Build a PRD
commands.description: Run the multi-lens PRD builder skill on a described product idea and write the result to docs/prd/ in the Blueprint project.

commands.title: Codalio Blueprint: Export Open Document
commands.description: Export the currently open generated planning document as a Markdown file.

exporters.title: Export Codalio Blueprint Markdown
exporters.description: Export the active generated planning document as a Markdown file.
